title: Check if you need to attend jury service
summary: Find out if you are required to attend jury service and learn about options for being excused, exempted, or excluded.
intro:
NSW residents are randomly selected from the NSW electoral roll each year and placed on a jury roll list.

Certain members of the public are eligible to be excused, exempted, or excluded from jury duty.

If you've received a summons to attend court for jury service, the document will provide you with:

As trials sometimes change at the last minute, you can check online if you're still required, from 4:30pm on the business day before you're due to attend court.

Note: If the trial is scheduled for a Monday, you can check after 4:30pm on the Friday.
who_can_apply: NSW residents are randomly selected from the NSW electoral roll each year and placed on a jury roll list.
what_you_need: If you receive a summons to attend court for jury service, the document will provide you with necessary information.
contact: For more information about the jury service, contact the NSW jury service or call the Jury Information Line on 1300 722 574 if you need help.

faqs.q: How do I check if I need to attend court for jury service?
faqs.a: You can check online if you are still required, starting from 4:30 pm on the business day before you are due to attend court. If the trial is scheduled for a Monday, you can check after 4:30 pm on the Friday.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to be excused, exempted, or excluded from jury duty?
faqs.a: Certain members of the public are eligible to be excused, exempted, or excluded from jury duty.

faqs.q: Who can I contact for more information about jury service?
faqs.a: Contact the NSW jury service or call the Jury Information Line on 1300 722 574.
